requirement: DanceFlow policy: proficiency_rating@1 stays rejected and three_band@1 (Bronze/Silver/Gold) accepts no ballot. Any ballot format that is not approved, or any scoring value with no ballot format, fails closed (COMP_BALLOT_FORMAT_NOT_APPROVED / COMP_BALLOT_SCORING_METHOD_UNSUPPORTED).
enforcement_point: _compe2_format_approved is checked in the submit RPC and in _compe2_guard_ballot_insert before any mark is validated; validateBallot refuses unregistered/unapproved formats.

tests.name: three_band (Bronze/Silver/Gold) fails closed even with valid-looking marks

interpretation_notes: R-07(3). Inspection finding (P3): _compe2_validate_marks still contains a three_band branch; it is unreachable because _compe2_format_approved runs first in both the RPC and the insert trigger. KNOWN GAP (P3, not reachable): ballotFormatForScoring indexes a plain object, so a prototype-chain name such as constructor returns a non-null value; every stored scoring value is CHECK-constrained, so no row can reach it. Application-layer behavior and static SQL parity are verified by EXECUTED tests (r07.failclosed.test.ts); the SQL runtime suites (sql-tests/test_T_competition_scoring_registry.sql, test_T_competition_e2_ballots.sql) were NOT RUN in this slice (heavy-lock queue), so the status stays unverified until their results are attached.
